quality.hardDesign: 정답 판단을 위해 (1) 분비선 제거 시 쇠퇴가 반전된다는 사실과 (2) '교미 후 며칠 이내에만' 반전이 가능하고 몇 주 후에는 불가역이라는 조건 단서를 모두 종합해야 하며, 각 오답은 이 조건 단서의 시간적 범위를 과장하거나(B), 원인 발생 시점을 뒤바꾸거나(C), 지문이 반박한 기존 가설을 반복(D)하는 서로 다른 오개념으로 설계되어 근거 없이는 소거되지 않는다.

problem.passage:
In several species of deep-sea squid, males undergo a dramatic change immediately following their single mating event: they stop hunting entirely, drift passively in the water column, and display a rapid deterioration of muscle tissue that culminates in death within weeks. Marine biologists initially attributed this decline to the sheer metabolic cost of producing and transferring the enormous spermatophore packets used during mating, reasoning that males simply exhausted their energy reserves in this one reproductive act. However, researchers studying the glass squid Teuthowenia noticed something that complicated this picture: when they surgically excised a small structure near the squid's esophagus called the juvenile gland—an organ that becomes active only after mating occurs and is otherwise dormant throughout the animal's life—males continued hunting normally, maintained stable muscle mass, and survived for several additional months, despite having transferred spermatophore packets of comparable mass to those of unaltered males. Notably, this extended survival occurred only when the gland was removed within days of mating; once several weeks had passed, removal no longer reversed the decline, suggesting the gland's signal, once fully released, could no longer be withdrawn. This pattern indicates that the male's post-mating deterioration is not ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
problem.stimulus: In several species of deep-sea squid, males undergo a dramatic change immediately following their single mating event: they stop hunting entirely, drift passively in the water column, and display a rapid deterioration of muscle tissue that culminates in death within weeks. Marine biologists initially attributed this decline to the sheer metabolic cost of producing and transferring the enormous spermatophore packets used during mating, reasoning that males simply exhausted their energy reserves in this one reproductive act. However, researchers studying the glass squid Teuthowenia noticed something that complicated this picture: when they surgically excised a small structure near the squid's esophagus called the juvenile gland—an organ that becomes active only after mating occurs and is otherwise dormant throughout the animal's life—males continued hunting normally, maintained stable muscle mass, and survived for several additional months, despite having transferred spermatophore packets of comparable mass to those of unaltered males. Notably, this extended survival occurred only when the gland was removed within days of mating; once several weeks had passed, removal no longer reversed the decline, suggesting the gland's signal, once fully released, could no longer be withdrawn. This pattern indicates that the male's post-mating deterioration is not ______
problem.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: a fixed consequence of the energy spent transferring spermatophores, but rather a process actively triggered by a glandular signal that can be interrupted only within a limited window after mating
a response that continues to be reversible no matter how much time has elapsed since the gland begins releasing its signal after mating
a change that begins only in the weeks following mating, once the gland's signal has had sufficient time to accumulate in the squid's tissues
the result of a glandular process at all, since the comparable spermatophore mass shows that energy expenditure alone fully explains the decline
problem.explanation: 지문은 두 가지를 종합해야 한다: (1) 분비선을 제거하면 동일한 에너지를 썼음에도 쇠퇴가 일어나지 않았다는 것, (2) 그러나 이 반전은 '교미 후 며칠 이내'라는 제한된 시간 안에서만 가능했고 몇 주가 지나면 되돌릴 수 없었다는 조건 단서다. 이 둘을 합치면 쇠퇴는 에너지 소모의 고정된 결과가 아니라 분비선의 신호로 능동적으로 촉발되며, 그 개입 가능 시점이 제한적이라는 결론(A)이 나온다. B는 '어느 시점에서도 되돌릴 수 있다'고 하여 지문이 명시한 제한된 시간 창(only within days) 조건을 무시한 범위 과장(WRONG_SCOPE) 오류다. C는 쇠퇴가 교미 후 몇 주가 지나서야 '시작'된다고 하는데, 지문은 쇠퇴가 교미 직후부터 이미 진행되고 있었고 단지 제거 가능 시점이 초기라는 것이므로 원인-결과의 시간 순서를 뒤바꾼 오류다(WRONG_SCOPE/원인·결과 전도). D는 에너지 소모만으로 완전히 설명된다며 지문이 정확히 반박한 기존 가설을 반복하는 것으로 지문의 결론과 정반대다(OPPOSITE).
